theme_and_archetype.description: Authority, clarity, and truth. Objective, rigid, and highly functional control room for system operators.
design_principles: Color is Function Only: 95% monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Density and Scanability: Every pixel utilized. Control Room Grid mode.
Expose the Skeleton: Visible grid borders, technical look.
No Decorative Graphics: Data is the UI.

fonts.usage: Data points, Timestamps, Incident IDs, PnL, Metrics

typography.scale_rules: H1 max text-3xl. Subheadings text-lg. Heavy use of uppercase, wide-tracking labels for metadata (text-xs uppercase tracking-widest).

layout_and_grids.strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_grids.structure: Base grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-12. Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
layout_and_grids.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Container uses pure HTML/Tailwind with border-collapse or distinct 1px border-gray-200. No glassmorphism. Flat solid backgrounds. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
layout_and_grids.spacing: Dense internal padding (p-4 or p-6) inside widgets to prevent text collision.

incident_stream.design: Vertical list, compact rows. Left-aligned border indicating severity color (e.g., 4px red border for critical). Hover state: bg-gray-50, cursor-pointer. Selected state must have a distinct background shift.

timeline_view.design: Vertical stepper layout. Monospace timestamps. Small circular nodes. Connecting line using border-gray-200. Staggered fade-in for new stream events.

root_cause_panel.design: Highlight box. High contrast text-lg font-bold text-gray-900. Confidence score in large mono font (e.g., text-3xl text-emerald-600). Neo-brutalist sharp 1px border.

action_panel.design: Square corners. Primary action: bg-black text-white hover:bg-gray-800. Critical Action (e.g., block trading): bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700. Explicit separation from analytical views.

impact_panel.design: Data-heavy metric cards. Big Monospace numbers. Red/Green text for negative/positive PNL impact.

policy_engine_panel.design: Table or rule-builder interface. IF/THEN block structures using monospace fonts for attributes (anomaly.type, severity). Tight layout.

prediction_trend_panel.design: Time-series line or bar charts. Minimal grid lines (only horizontal, stroke-dasharray). Tooltips must have sharp corners and solid backgrounds.

graph_drilldown.design: Stark geometry for nodes (squares/circles). Monochrome links. Highlighted paths use semantic colors (blue/red). Black-and-white base aesthetic until a node is active.

rules: Real-time event streams should flash softly (e.g., bg-blue-50 to transparent over 1s) to indicate new data.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight. Consistent line thickness.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: MANDATORY. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='incident-item-INC-123', data-testid='trigger-action-restart-worker', data-testid='timeline-view-node').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Explicitly set hover text colors.

tech_stack_overrides.ui_library: Shadcn UI (customized for sharp edges and density), Recharts for time-series.
tech_stack_overrides.empty_states: Use typography and borders. Do not use placeholder images.
